caption:
Why don't you feel hip thrusts in your glutes? 🍑

3 things I fix with every client:
1️⃣ Ribs down, chin tucked — don't arch your lower back
2️⃣ Feet a little wider, push through your heels
3️⃣ Pause at the top for 1 second and squeeze

Lighter weight, better reps. That's how you build strength that lasts.

Where do you feel it — glutes, back or hamstrings? 👇
Comment "START" and I'll help you start.
